summary: I just think we took the wrong take away from the Web 2.0 marketing meme... It should not have been "Now no one needs to learn HTML to get online," but should have been "Oh crap let's teach web literacy to all or we will be owned"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I just think we took the wrong take away from the Web 2.0 marketing meme... It should not have been "Now no one needs to learn HTML to get online," but should have been "Oh crap let's teach web literacy to all or we will be owned"
